name: Ramon Orriols
headline: ERP Transformation Leader | Private Equity | Strategy | AI | Delivery | Business Change | Deployment | Value Realisation | Advisory | D365 | SAP S/4 | Oracle | Revolutionising your Transformation. Delivery guaranteed.
about:
With more than 15 years of consulting experience, Ramon main areas of expertise are focused on SAP, ERP and technology programme delivery, change and transformation, having worked with different client organisations worldwide, developing, shaping and delivering large scale business transformation programmes. 

Industry experience includes: PE, Tech, Consumer, Life Sciences, Prof. Services, Auto, Manufacturing, Retail, Media and FS. 

Specialities: 
* Programme, Project Management and PMO 
* Change Management & Enablement
* Enterprise Agility, Product and Agile Delivery Management
* Programme Recovery and Quality Assurance
* Leadership Engagement, Stakeholders and Journey Management 
* Business Case development, Benefits Realisation and Value Creation 
* Planning, Resource and Scope Management 
* Build, Configuration, Integration, Release and Test Management 
* Data Extraction, Transformation, Upload and Verification
* Change Impacts Assessment and Action Plans
* Change Network and Super Users set up and Delivery Management 
* Knowledge Transfer, Communications, Role Mapping and Training 
* Deployment Preparation, Cutover Execution, Transition Management and Hypercare 
* Business Readiness and Adoption tracking 
* Organisation Design/ Target Operating Model
* Vendor/ System Integrator Selection, Contract and Relationship Management
* Quality Assurance and Programme Recovery
* Platforms: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, Ariba, IBP, EWM, Concur, C/4, SF, D365, Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow
* Key Process Areas: Opportunity to Cash, Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Supply, Ops, Manufacturing, Warehouse, Logistics
* Methods and Tools: SAP Activate, RISE, Microsoft Success by Design, Oracle ERP, PRINCE2, MSP, ADKAR, Prosci, Jira, Azure DevOps
… more

experiences.description:
Transform ERP brings a unique proposition to help clients shape, develop and deliver ERP and technology enabled programmes. 
 
We understand the complexities to define the right transformation programme for your business: from selecting the right technology, defining the scope, bringing your business leaders onboard and selecting the right System Integrator partner.

Transform ERP brings the delivery experience to help you set strong teams that will work hand in hand with your business leaders and the selected System Integrator, building your internal capabilities through the programme and helping you to manage (rather than being managed by) the System Integrator partner. We can also advice at any stage of the programme if you are looking for independent views, helping you to recover and bring a programme back on track.

Visit our webpage transform-erp.com to explore our offerings and some of our success stories!

o ERP Transformation Leader assessing the right next ERP solution for a global consumer manufacturer, driving a like-for-like comparison across potential solutions and detailing the benefits and fit-to-standard approach, as well as the overall business case and implementation plan for each of the options.
